title: Urgent Update: Last Chance for MEF 2026-27 Submission!
content:
# Urgent Update: Last Chance for MEF 2026-27 Submission!

Ek important update hai for all practicing CAs! The Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI) ne Multipurpose Empanelment Form (MEF) 2026-27 submission ke liye ek final opportunity announce ki hai.

Due to numerous requests from members who couldn't submit their MEF applications earlier, the Professional Development Committee, ICAI, has decided to provide this last window.

Here are the key details:

*   **Announcement Date:** October 14, 2026
*   **Last Opportunity Submission Window:** From October 15, 2026 (Midnight) to October 16, 2026 (Midnight) only.
*   **Purpose:** This is the absolute final chance to submit your MEF 2026-27. Please note, no further extensions will be granted.

Members are advised to utilize this limited period and submit their applications on the MEF portal at https://meficai.org/. Don't miss this opportunity!

## Read the Official Document
*   [Download the Official Notification/Circular here](https://www.icai.org/quick-links/)

*Published on: 16 October 2026*
